verdicts.rationale: Three of four clauses are met. Students work with others to discuss topics: they respond to whole-group discussion prompts ("What did we do that is similar to what astronomers do?") and engage in turn-and-talk with elbow partners. Students work with others to explore and create texts: they share their self-created "What the Sun Sees" poems and Sky notebooks in collaborative small groups. However, no activity has students work with others to solve problems — the lesson is a sharing/celebration lesson with no problem-solving component, so that clause is not met.
